headlines: TSM is the one to watch. It's inside a flip zone that has been moving ($342–368), under its largest $390 level (+1.1K). Support at $342.5 is weak; below that there's none around $320. It's net negative into opex (−44.9K), so swings are likely to be bigger.
AAPL has the most positioning into opex (+221K), centred on $360–370. It's also sitting on its $348 flip.
GOOGL is on its $268–283 flip zone but net negative into opex (−42.7K), so swings are likely to be bigger. TSLA faces resistance at $382.5–400 (and it's sitting on its $372–392 flip zone).
AMZN and AVGO closed below their flips ($247–257 and $316), so moves can run until they get back above.
Looking to the 1/15 opex, AAPL has the most positioning (+361K); NVDA, AVGO, and TSM stay net negative into both opex dates.
NVDA is the weakest board, at −115K into opex. It's below its $153–166 flip zone, and TradeEcho rates it 2/5.
